country: Multi-country (Ethiopia, Ghana, Honduras, India, Pakistan, Peru)
evaluation_method: Individual and Cluster Randomized Controlled Trials
intervention_description: A comprehensive program targeting ultra-poor households with productive asset transfer, consumption support, skills training, coaching, savings encouragement, and basic health services

intervention_start.literal_text: Between 2007 and 2014, we conducted a multisite RCT of the Graduation program

intervention_end.literal_text: Between 2007 and 2014, we conducted a multisite RCT of the Graduation program

final_followup.literal_text: Data were collected at baseline and immediately after the programs ended, 2 years later ('endline 1'), and again 1 year after the programs ended, i.e., about 3 years after the beginning of the programs ('endline 2')

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Regular transfer of food or cash for a few months to about a year
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Health education, basic health services, and/or life-skills training
graduation_components_rationale.assets: One-time transfer of a productive asset chosen by the household
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Technical skills training on managing productive assets
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Access to savings accounts and deposit collection services
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: High-frequency home visits providing training and encouragement
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Village assistance committees and group activities

outcomes.outcome_description: Per capita consumption in PPP USD
outcomes.literal_text: Per capita consumption increases by 0.12 SDs (q-value 0.001), which is equivalent to PPP US$4.55 per capita per month

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: Endline 1 was conducted immediately following the end of the household visits, which was typically 2 years after the transfer of productive assets

outcomes.literal_text: An index of food security increases by 0.11 SDs (q-value 0.001)
